lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out with Molly in her dorm.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚去 Molly 的宿舍陪她待着。

lines.en: She spends the entirety of our time together trying to convince me to get into some video game that she likes and will not allow me to change the topic no matter how hard I try.
lines.zh: 我们相处的整个过程里，她都在试图拉我入坑她喜欢的某个电子游戏，不管我怎么努力，她都不肯让我换话题。

lines.en: Normally, I'm fine with girls taking the lead in conversations so I don't need to divulge any information about myself-
lines.zh: 一般来说，我很乐意让女孩子主导对话，这样我就不用透露自己的任何信息——

lines.en: But I'd at least prefer to understand what it is that my partner is talking about.
lines.zh: 但我至少希望自己能听懂对方在说什么。

lines.en: Regardless, I pretend to be interested because it makes Molly happy. And even if she's exhausting to be around, her mischievous smile always seems to strike energy back into me.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我还是装出很感兴趣的样子，因为这让 Molly 开心。而且就算和她待在一起很累，她那副淘气的笑容总能重新给我注入能量。

lines.en: Eventually, it begins to get late and I decide to head home before Tsuneyo gets back from the ramen shop.
lines.zh: 最后天色渐晚，我决定在 Tsuneyo 从拉面店回来之前先回家。

lines.en: Molly awkwardly lunges forward as if she wants to hug me but then backs off and gives me a military-style salute instead.
lines.zh: Molly 笨拙地向前一扑，像是要抱我，随后又退开，改成给了我一个标准的军礼。
